name: Stability Craving
description: Wants the ground to stop moving long enough to build something on it
behavioral_signature: Seeks predictability and permanence in an unstable world
under_stress: Clings to failing structures because the alternative is freefall
at_rest: Builds routines, maintains relationships, invests in the long term
will_never: risk what's working for what might be better
unless: stability has become stagnation and the cost of staying is higher than leaving
